en.text:
Kills in Auto Rifle mode grant 'Overcharge' stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks. 

<link Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.

At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to change this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal <pve 1475 /> <pvp [537] /> precision damage and 200% increased damage against <link Champions [#CombatantClassifications] />. Stowing after activation removes all charged shots.

Precision Kills while in this mode trigger a <solar/>Solar Ignition that deals 5% more damage than base.

Exiting Linear Mode refills the magazine.
